title: Emerson book cipher: historical control reproduction
question: Do the archived opening-image coordinates reproduce the documented historical string with the frozen Emerson PDF derivative and its declared conventions?
summary: The pinned PDF re-extracts to all 50 stored paragraphs. Fifteen coordinate lookups plus seven literal characters reproduce the documented historical string and complete trace.

scope.representation: Frozen opening-image coordinate payload, pinned Emerson PDF, and its 50-paragraph derivative; exact source hashes. Historical reconstruction conventions retained.
scope.procedure: Re-extract PDF with pypdf 6.19.0, compare all paragraphs, parse four-part one-based coordinates and literal characters, and compare the complete lookup trace with the known control.
scope.parameters: 50 paragraphs; 15 lookups; seven literal characters; one source edition and convention set. Two complete runs. Known answer exposed before testing.
scope.exclusions: Other editions, other texts, arbitrary coordinate searches, unsolved-page transfer and validation of any current network destination.

finding: All 50 paragraphs and the complete 22-character trace reproduce: auqgnxjtvdbll3pv.onion. Supported only as a historical control under the declared conventions.
limitations: Not blind discovery. Earlier paragraph handling was corrected after mismatches; that rule is frozen here. Creator edition not authenticated. No unsolved-page transfer or network destination tested. Human review pending.
next_steps: Use the control to verify implementations. Different editions or coordinate conventions require variants; unsolved-page hypotheses require separately justified coordinates and criteria.
